summary: This subroutine sets up database connection credentials (server, database, username, and password) on a cData object, then executes a SQL query that copies results into the active Excel sheet starting at cell A1.

explanations.3: This declares a variable named rng that will hold a Range object—think of it as a container ready to store a reference to cells in a spreadsheet.
explanations.5: cData is an object (probably a database connection helper) and we're assigning the server name to its ServerName property, like filling in a form field.
explanations.12: We call a method on cData that runs the SQL query and places the results starting at cell A1, then store the resulting range of cells in our rng variable so we can reference it later if needed.
